title: Virupaksha
desc: While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.

title: Cobra
desc: A genius mathematician uses his skills to assassinate his targets and stay clear of law enforcement. However, a vigilante secretly tracks his movements, vying for revenge.

title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.
A gangster deploys two of his trusted men in different cities to extort money from people who have escaped. While on their mission, they find themselves in various adventurous situations.

title: Waltair Veerayya
desc: Waltair Veerayya, a fisherman and smuggler, is in dire need of money in order to fight a court case. Later, he is approached by an officer to extradite Solomon Caesar, an infamous drug lord for money.
